title: Coty continues transformation as quarterly profit jumps 64%
summary: The American cosmetics and fragrance group Coty (Marc Jacobs, Burberry fragrances, Calvin Klein, etc.) reported a 64% increase in profit for the July–September period, supported by demand in its key markets and proceeds from the sale of one of its licenses. Currently undergoing a transformation, the group posted a profit of USD 106 million in the first quarter of its 2026/2027 fiscal year, compared with USD 65 million a year earlier, according to a press release issued on Wednesday,... - Industry buzz

extraction.key_fact: 코티가 분기 이익이 늘었고 마크 제이콥스와의 라이선스 계약을 연장했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Coty also announced a 40-year extension of its licensing partnership with Marc Jacobs , which began in 2003.
